CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

2. Which response best shows understanding of Who is CREATION? (1 mark)
   A. Use Who is CREATION to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Who is CREATION.
   C. Say Who is CREATION has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Who is CREATION with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Love of God and? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Love of God and with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Love of God and has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Love of God and to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Love of God and.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Birth of Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. Say Birth of Jesus has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Birth of Jesus.
   C. Apply the teaching of Birth of Jesus with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Birth of Jesus to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND.
   B. Apply the teaching of Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND has no place in daily life.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

7. Which response best shows understanding of Communicating to? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Communicating to with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Communicating to to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Communicating to has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Communicating to.

8. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible BIBLE? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Bible BIBLE has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible BIBLE.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Bible BIBLE with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use The Bible BIBLE to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Church as a place? (1 mark)
   A. Use Church as a place to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Church as a place has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Church as a place with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Church as a place.

10. Which response best shows understanding of My family CREATION? (1 mark)
   A. Say My family CREATION has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My family CREATION.
   C. Apply the teaching of My family CREATION with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use My family CREATION to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Christian festivals: RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Christian festivals: RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS.
   B. Say Christian festivals: RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Christian festivals: RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Christian festivals: RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Church as a place and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Who is CREATION and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain My family CREATION and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Communicating to and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

7. A — Apply the teaching of Communicating to with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. C — Apply the teaching of Church as a place with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
